title: URL Encode Decode
description: Encode and decode URL components, URIs, and form values in the browser without sending content to the server.
metaDescription: Encode and decode URL components, URIs, and form values in the browser without sending content to the server.

form.title: Encode and decode URL
form.description: Paste a URL part, full URI, or form value to convert it with percent-encoding rules.

input.title: Input
input.label: Text, component, or URL
input.privacy: Conversion happens in your browser. This tool does not fetch, open, validate, or send pasted URLs.

options.title: Operation and context
options.description: Choose whether the input is an isolated component, a full URI, or a form/query value.

contexts.label: Context
contexts.description: Component encodes delimiters such as &, =, /, and ?. URI preserves structural delimiters. Form uses + for spaces.

strict.label: Strict RFC 3986 component
strict.disabled: Applies only when encoding in Component context.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the link stores only operation, context, and strict mode.
share.includeContent: Include input in the shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include pasted input.
share.publicWarning: Links with content expose the input to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The input is too large for a safe link. The link will include only settings and the content option.

result.title: Result
result.description: Decoding validates % escapes before calling browser APIs.
result.emptyDescription: Paste a value to encode or decode.
result.validEncodeDescription: Output for {context} generated with {bytes} UTF-8 bytes.
result.validDecodeDescription: {context} input decoded to text with {bytes} UTF-8 bytes.

errors.inputTooLarge: The input exceeds this tool's size limit.

seoDetails.title: How URL encoding works
seoDetails.percentDescription: Characters outside the safe set become UTF-8 bytes written as %HH. Generated escapes stay uppercase.
seoDetails.contextDescription: Component protects isolated values; URI keeps : / ? # & and other delimiters; form turns spaces into +.
seoDetails.privacyDescription: Signed URLs, tokens, and keys may appear in decoded text. Share content in a link only when it may be read by others.

privacy.question: Is the text sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Conversion happens in the browser and the tool does not open or check the pasted URL. Input only enters the link when you enable that option.

difference.question: What is the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
difference.answer: encodeURI is for an already structured URI and preserves delimiters. encodeURIComponent is for an isolated value and encodes delimiters such as &, =, /, and ?.

space.question: When does a space become + instead of %20?
space.answer: In form value context, following application/x-www-form-urlencoded. In component and URI contexts, a space becomes %20.

percent25.question: Why does %25 appear in the result?
percent25.answer: Because % also has to be encoded. If the input already had %20, encoding again turns the % into %25.

decodeFailed.question: Why did decoding fail?
decodeFailed.answer: Because there was a malformed % escape or a byte sequence that does not represent valid UTF-8 text.

safety.question: Does this validate whether a URL is safe or exists?
safety.answer: No. The tool only encodes and decodes text. It does not check DNS, redirects, malware, phishing, or reachability.

sharing.question: Can I share already filled input?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only after enabling the option to include input in the link. Do not use that with tokens, signed URLs, passwords, personal data, or private logs.

seo.about: The tool encodes and decodes percent-encoding for URL components, full URIs, and application/x-www-form-urlencoded values. It shows stable errors for malformed % escapes, invalid UTF-8 bytes, invalid Unicode, and oversized input.
seo.howToUseTitle: How to encode and decode URLs online
seo.howToUse: Paste the input, choose encode or decode, select the correct context, and copy or download the output. Shared links preserve only settings by default; include input in the link only when it can be public.
